services.name: Kids Self Defense
services.desc: This class is tailored for individuals new to the world of mixed martial arts. Students will be taught the essential techniques of different martial arts styles, including muay thai, boxing, wrestling, and jiu-jitsu. Through focused technical exercises and live practice scenarios, participants will grasp the core moves utilized in MMA. Be prepared to pair up and work up a sweat. MMA combines various martial arts disciplines, providing a full-body workout that enhances strength, endurance, and flexibility. The dynamic nature of MMA training not only improves cardiovascular fitness but also sharpens mental focus and discipline. Additionally, it offers a fun and engaging way to relieve stress
